name: North-star: Leaderboard

queries.name: main
queries.sql:
SELECT UserId AS user, uniqExact(TraceId) AS traces
FROM trace_metrics
WHERE UserId IS NOT NULL AND UserId != ''
  AND OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
  AND TotalDurationMs > 0
GROUP BY user
ORDER BY traces DESC
LIMIT 10
